about_p1: Studify is an education platform built to help students find the right teacher easily, quickly, and reliably.
about_p2: Our goal is to bring students together with experienced, knowledgeable teachers, making the process of finding a tutor easier and more accessible. Students can discover teachers that match their subject and needs; teachers can share their knowledge and experience with more students.
about_p3: We believe that connecting the right teacher with the right student makes learning more effective and more enjoyable. With that belief, we felt that location or borders shouldn't stop anyone from reaching a great teacher — which is why we built Studify to be accessible from anywhere in the world.
about_p4: Studify was founded by Muhammadali Memmedov, from the village of Karachop in Georgia's Kakheti region.
about_p5: Studify — the easiest way for anyone who wants to learn to find the right teacher.
